name: imagine being so _
what_it_is: Imagine being so _ means picture yourself being so _. Creators open with it to invite viewers to picture an extreme quality and the reaction it provokes, in a playful, dramatic or affectionate register. The blank holds that quality and outcome, sometimes a promise to explain, e.g. important to someone that they send you this.

examples.hook_text: Imagine being so gorgeous someone sent you this
Imagine being so good at your sport that you get the police called on you for it. Let me explain.
